name: Perseids
description: A meteor shower: streaks of light fly out of one radiant above the sheet, short near it and longer far away, among still stars.

code.style: --rule: ( --jx: @r(-22%, 22%); --jy: @r(-22%, 22%); --len: @calc(min(2, 0.25 + sqrt((@dx - (-0.2 * @X)) * (@dx - (-0.2 * @X)) + (@dy - (-0.62 * @Y)) * (@dy - (-0.62 * @Y))) * 0.2) * @r(0.5, 1.1) * 100)%; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; width: @var(--len); height: 3.6%; left: calc(50% + @var(--jx) - @var(--len)); top: calc(50% + @var(--jy) - 1.8%); transform-origin: 100% 50%; transform: rotate(@calc(atan2((@dy - (-0.62 * @Y)), (@dx - (-0.2 * @X))) * 180 / PI)deg); border-radius: 99px; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 85%); opacity: @p(1, 1, 1, 0.7, 0); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 6.4%; height: 6.4%; left: calc(50% + @var(--jx) - 3.2%); top: calc(50% + @var(--jy) - 3.2%); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
